# DarkSlide v1.3.1

DarkSlide 1.3.1 adds flat-field correction for camera scans and warns when a RAW scan's film base is clipped. Conversions are unchanged unless you choose a flat-field reference.

## Highlights

- **Flat-field correction for RAW scans.** Lens vignetting and an unevenly lit light source make the edges of a camera scan darker, and often a different colour, than the centre. The density inversion reads that as film density, so corners print too bright and pick up a cast that changes across the frame. Shoot one frame of the bare light source with the same camera, lens, aperture and light as your scans, and choose it in Settings → Calibration. DarkSlide divides every RAW opened afterwards by that map, in linear light, before it measures the film base, the colour balance or the starting exposure. The map is normalized to the centre of the frame, so the centre keeps its exposure and colour. Dust on the light source is ignored, and a reference with film, a holder or a picture in it is refused. Scans from a different camera are left untouched and flagged.
- **Clipped film base warning.** When the clear film base of a RAW scan reaches the sensor's limit in any channel, every colour measured against it is off and no later setting can recover it. DarkSlide now says so at import, so the next scan can be exposed a little lower.

## Desktop Downloads

GitHub Actions builds and attaches installers for each supported desktop platform:

- macOS: universal Apple Silicon and Intel `.dmg`
- Windows: `.msi` and NSIS `.exe`
- Linux: `.deb` and `.AppImage`

## Installation Notes

- macOS builds are not notarized. On first launch, macOS may require opening the app through System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
- Windows and Linux builds are unsigned.

## Credits

The flat-field approach follows [FreeCCR](https://github.com/toonoumi/FreeCCR) and [NegPy](https://github.com/marcinz606/NegPy), which both correct uneven illumination in linear light before inverting. NegPy's scan-clip meter inspired the clipped-base warning. No code was copied.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kilianvivien/DarkSlide/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
